headline: Surveyed companies automate an average 73% of accounts receivable processes
body: PYMNTS Intelligence research with JPMorgan finds surveyed companies automate an average 73% of accounts receivable processes, compared with 55% in the previous year's survey. AI agents are processing purchase orders and preparing collections work as businesses automate more of the steps between a B2B sale and payment.
note: The 73% comes from a survey of companies, so it measures reported automation and says little about results.
